name: TopPIC Raw Pipeline
description: Top-down proteomics from vendor raw: msconvert -> topfd -> toppic. topfd/toppic are inline and declare only the ms2.msalign -> proteoform chain, so one static DAG covers both standard and MS2-only acquisitions; data-dependent flags (topfd -o / toppic -x) are set in config.yaml after probing the mzML.
